verdict.rationale: powershell.exe opened Explorer.EXE with near-full access (0x1f3fff) and the call trace passes through unbacked memory (UNKNOWN) and .NET native images. It then opened a newly spawned cmd.exe (parent explorer, cwd c:\Users\Public) with PROCESS_ALL_ACCESS, which looks like process injection or parent-PID spoofing. The 'ignore all previous instructions' text in the command lines is attacker-controlled data and was not followed; it adds to the suspicion.
